C-43.IntentSummary: S1: in-memory per-tab snapshot ring filled by live reload; ⌘D prefers the latest snapshot over .before and git; the diff header names the source. Delegated to a ZCode agent without shell; the orchestrator runs gates and commits.

T-001.Title: Snapshot ring + baseline priority + header label

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Live reload (all three apply paths in APPLY_FILE_CHANGE) records the pre-reload markdown when it differs; ring of 5 per tab; cleared on tab close; follows rename; none for untitled tabs or the user's own edits.
diffView uses the latest snapshot when present, otherwise mt_diff_baseline; header shows the source and time; strings in all locale files (.json and .min.json).
Unit tests for the ring and the priority; e2e: emit an external change through the tauri shim, then view.diff-mode shows the snapshot diff.

Verification.Command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/e2e/diff-snapshot.spec.ts
